Her main open concern from the demo was disruption to existing front-desk workflows, since she already has two receptionists and mainly struggles at lunch and peak hours. The decision window is now open and nothing is outstanding on our side.

narrative.relationship_summary: Willow Creek Dental has been a customer since 30 September 2025 and reported in March that the system noticeably reduced missed calls. Amanda Foster asked about including call analytics in a monthly report, and we shared the current reporting options on 1 April 2026. There has been no contact since then, a gap of about five months, and the one-year anniversary of the relationship falls at the end of September. The account looks healthy but is unattended, and we never learned whether the reporting options met Amanda's need.
narrative.priority_reason: A satisfied customer has gone 153 days without contact just as the first-year anniversary at the end of September approaches.
narrative.next_action: Email Amanda Foster to check in on how the system is performing, confirm whether the reporting options we shared in April met her analytics need, and set a time to review the first year.
narrative.follow_up_rationale: Reaching out in the first week of September gives time for a conversation and any account review before the 30 September one-year mark.

narrative.next_action: Send Laura Stone a short, low-pressure note in mid-September to confirm the planning meeting happened and whether budget for the five locations was approved.
narrative.follow_up_rationale: Respects Laura's request not to push before the September planning meeting while checking in early enough to keep the enterprise pricing decision moving.
